gate: npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run db:check && go test ./... && golangci-lint run

areas.name: backend
areas.description: Go app and worker: API, webhooks, setup, queue, Renovate runner, GitHub client, ticket engine

areas.name: web
areas.description: Next.js UI, COSS, /setup and sign-in pages, Go API proxy

areas.name: config
areas.description: Environment settings and startup validation, Compose reference

areas.name: ci
areas.description: GitHub Actions, Dockerfile (app and worker images), Renovate pin and fixture scripts, GHCR

areas.name: docs
areas.description: Spec docs, threat model, customer docs site, agent workflow config

maintainerOnly.name: maintainer
maintainerOnly.description: Maintainer-only work (deploys, live checks, merges, releases); never dispatched to an agent

risk.name: risk
risk.description: Can lose data or break upgrades: schema, migrations, credential crypto, GitHub App key, setup, token minting, worker auth

checks.run: npm test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test ./... && golangci-lint run
